official_definition: By sending an opposing exhausted Spirit to the Hand, send an opposing Life to the Reserve, and put a core from the Void to each of your "God-King"/"Ten Crown" family Spirits.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Leap] or [Leap: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Leap]", "give [Leap]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
